code_mappings: Native option insertion order and its reverse; exactly two unique mappings.
coverage: Missing other code is fetched with identical prompt and forced singleton; no floor.
output_contract: Intermediate native key only; not a complete native JSON/explanation head.
reasoned: Original full messages + new raw assistant response (may include explanation and answer) + identical selector. No old answer.
selection: Existing frozen inputs/evaluation; no selection or input changes; gold offline only; no prior.
decision_frozen: Equal semantic probability from direct and reasoned, each in two unique A/B maps; no alpha or threshold search. See already saved nli_choice/equal_path_ensemble.py.
